name: Hisense TV
author: meviusisback
description: Control a Hisense VIDAA TV from the Omarchy bar: power, volume, D-pad, inputs and app launch over the TV's local MQTT bus — no cloud, no account, no vendor app running.

barWidget.description: Hisense VIDAA remote: power, volume, D-pad, inputs, apps.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: Status shows the live channel/app and volume; Icon shows a single glyph.

schema.label: Show volume in the bar
schema.description: Append the current volume level while the TV is on.
